messages:
alex: Quick async check — Q2 OKR milestone for Runtime v2 rollout. TL;DR: ship window moved. Who owns the canary rollout and what's blocking capacity? @maria @dave

maria: I'm owning canary. Canary passed perf tests yesterday but we hit a kernel mismatch on GPU pool B. Investigating with eng-runtime.

dave: cc @alex @sophie saw the mismatch — appears to be a cudnn vs compiled-kernel issue after the quant patch. I can repro with this command:
```
./run_infer --model=rv2-quant --gpu=pool-B --seq=1024
```
will push a minimal repro to the PR.

sophie: FYI product: this delay pushes the customer pilot to next week if we don't get canary by EOD Friday. Suggest we decouple pilot scale from full canary; can ship smaller pilot to select customers.

alex: Good call. @sophie please list minimum acceptance criteria for pilot (latency, errors, webhook stability).

sophie: Min AC: p99 latency < 350ms, error rate < 0.5%, stable webhook retry logic with idempotency header. I'll add to the shared doc: https://redwood.docs/okrs/q2/runtime-v2-pilot

leo: I can reconfigure pool fallback to route canary to pool-A as temporary workaround. Need approval for cost bump (~+12% for the week).

maria: Approve fallback to pool-A for canary. @finance FYI cost spike.

deploy-bot: deploy started by dave on branch `fix/quant-kernel-repro` -> status: running

dave: pushed small kernel selection fallback; monitoring logs: `tail -f /var/log/rv2/canary.log`

alex: If fallback resolves perf, we proceed with canary and mark milestone as shipped for internal OKR. If not, mark as slipped and list next steps.

maria: Expected next steps if slip: roll back quant patch, create hotfix train, engage infra for dedicated pool testing.

sophie: I've updated the OKR tracker with both paths and owners. Link: https://redwood.okr/q2/runtime-v2 — see row 3 (canary).

alex: Thanks all. Quick asks: @dave drop PR link here, @maria update timeline in tracker, @leo confirm cost impact after reconfig. Will follow up in tomorrow standup. :thumbsup:
